With You - Mitsumete Itai.name: With You: Mitsumete Itai
With You - Mitsumete Itai.summary: With You: Mitsumete Itai is an Adventure game, developed and published by NEC Interchannel, which was released in Japan in 1999 for the Sega Saturn, followed by a WonderSwan Color version in 2001, developed by Shall Luck and published by Cocktail Soft.
